management_fx.basis: Invented fixed exercise assumption, not a market quotation

commercial.benefit_definition: Customer actual tax saving or refund, not qualifying expenditure

source_precedence: P&Ls contain synthetic amounts and employee counts. The two US research hires below are explicit exercise additions and override historical statements about the US team for this scenario. Transcripts preserve historical statements. CRM and handover summaries are secondary records, not independently verified facts.

additional_assumptions.filing_windows: Assume open and required notification completed for this exercise

us_activity_start.basis: Exact day is an exercise assumption; September call describes February start. Q1 has no activity. Q2 contains only February–March activity.

us_staffing.start_day_assumption: First day of each month for headcount averaging
us_staffing.basis: Commercial functions and months follow the September call. Research hires are fictional additions, not claims about real employees. All costs are included in the aggregate US P&L; individual compensation is not supplied.

additional_assumptions.headcount_basis: Employees only, excluding external advisers and contractors. Quarterly averages are rounded to 2 decimals; annual average is the mean of quarterly averages, rounded to 2 decimals. Synthetic closing count is 21 UK + 4 US = 25, including the two fictional research hires.
additional_assumptions.accounting_basis: Accrual-basis management P&Ls; revenue is recognised income, not cash receipts. US first exercise period is February–September 2026, displayed in the common October–September reporting grid with zero pre-start activity. No conclusion on historical backdating is assumed.
